edits.old: it is held as a secret reference and never written in a values file.
edits.new: it is held as a secret reference and never written in a values file. This story exposes no REST operation and calls no rwb-access authorise check (DP-08); the channel path is authorised by the workload identity and the ACLs of section 11. The run record, the rerun operation and the fields of the run answer are owned by RWB-P5-E1057-CON; the partner check goes through the rwb-partner contract with a fake and carries no C row (GAP-1012). The JOB-12 run read and rerun go through the rwb-source-data admin job contract, and the four channels are proven through the intake contract and DocumentIntakeWorkflow (GAP-0367). The business-hours window, the overlap policy and the catch-up window of the intake Schedule are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1012); the Schedule owner confirms them before the wave 1 release. The mail service of the mailbox channel, the partner DMZ position and the scan rate are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1014); the network and security owners confirm them before the wave 1 release.
